name: Exp_RAVI_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on the RAVI (Range Action Verification Index) Histogram indicator, which measures momentum by comparing fast and slow moving averages. It opens buy positions when the RAVI value crosses above the upper level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level, with corresponding close signals for opposite positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RAVI直方图指标进行交易，通过比较快速和慢速移动平均线来衡量动量。当RAVI值从下方穿越上轨时开多仓，从上方穿越下轨时开空仓，同时对反向持仓发出平仓信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是RAVI（Range Action Verification Index）直方图指标，通过计算快速和慢速平滑移动平均线的差值来衡量市场动量方向。入场条件为：当RAVI值高于上轨（UpLevel=+0.1）且前一根柱的值低于上轨时，触发做多开仓信号；当RAVI值低于下轨（DnLevel=-0.1）且前一根柱的值高于下轨时，触发做空开仓信号。出场条件方面，做多信号触发时同时平空仓，做空信号触发时同时平多仓，另外设有固定止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持多种保证金模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损后余额、固定手数）。资金管理采用MarginMode枚举，默认为固定手数模式（LOT），MM=0.1表示资金分配比例。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保仅在新的K线形成时执行信号判断，避免重复交易，同时通过SignalBar参数控制使用哪根K线的信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the RAVI (Range Action Verification Index) Histogram indicator, which measures market momentum direction by calculating the difference between fast and slow smoothed moving averages. Entry conditions: when the RAVI value is above the upper level (UpLevel=+0.1) and the previous bar's value was below or equal to the upper level, a buy open signal is triggered; when the RAVI value is below the lower level (DnLevel=-0.1) and the previous bar's value was above or equal to the lower level, a sell open signal is triggered. For exit conditions, when a buy signal triggers, existing sell positions are simultaneously closed, and vice versa; additionally, fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) are configured. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the risk ratio, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MarginMode enumeration, defaulting to fixed lot mode (LOT), with MM=0.1 representing the capital allocation ratio. The strategy employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal evaluation only occurs on new bar formation, preventing duplicate trades, while the SignalBar parameter controls which bar's signal is used for analysis.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金分配比例，控制每笔交易的资金占比

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 保证金模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/drawdown free margin/drawdown balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: FastPhase
parameters.description: 快速平滑相位参数（JJMA/VIDYA/AMA适用）

parameters.name: SlowPhase
parameters.description: 慢速平滑相位参数（JJMA/VIDYA/AMA适用）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号检测的K线索引

pros: 采用多周期指标（H4），避免了短周期噪音干扰，适合捕捉中期趋势动量
提供完整的开平仓开关控制，可以灵活只启用做多或做空方向
使用IsNewBar机制防止同一K线内重复交易，减少不必要的交易频率
支持10种平滑算法和9种价格类型，参数灵活度高，可适应不同市场环境
设置了止损和止盈，风险可控，盈亏比2:1较为合理
pros_en: Uses multi-timeframe indicator (H4), avoiding short-period noise interference, suitable for capturing medium-term trend momentum
Provides complete open/close toggle controls, allowing flexible enabling of only buy or sell directions
Employs IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar, reducing unnecessary trading frequency
Supports 10 smoothing algorithms and 9 price types, offering high parameter flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Configured with stop loss and take profit, risk is controllable with a reasonable 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点数值过大，在多数品种上可能导致单笔风险过高
缺乏点差过滤机制，在点差较大的品种上可能导致不必要的亏损
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
信号逻辑简单，仅依赖RAVI穿越阈值，在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号
Recount静态变量在CopyBuffer失败时置为true，但缺乏最大重试次数限制，可能无限循环重试
cons_en: Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, potentially leading to high per-trade risk on most instruments
Lacks spread filtering mechanism, which may cause unnecessary losses on instruments with wide spreads
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction when already holding
Simple signal logic relying solely on RAVI crossing threshold levels may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets
The Recount static variable is set to true on CopyBuffer failure but lacks a maximum retry limit, potentially causing infinite retry loops
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同向重复开仓，并加入最大持仓数量限制
添加点差过滤和波动率过滤（如ATR），在市场条件不适宜时抑制交易信号
将止损止盈参数改为基于ATR的动态计算，而非固定点数，以适应不同品种的波动特性
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid duplicate same-direction entries, and implement maximum position count limits
Add spread filtering and volatility filtering (e.g., ATR) to suppress trading signals when market conditions are unfavorable
Change stop loss and take profit parameters to ATR-based dynamic calculation instead of fixed points, to adapt to different instruments' volatility characteristics

risk_points: 固定止损1000点在某些品种上可能过大，单笔亏损可能占总资金比例过高
缺乏持仓数量限制和同向重复开仓检查，可能导致过度持仓
没有点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大时仍会执行交易
Recount机制无重试上限，可能在指标数据异常时陷入循环
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss of 1000 points may be excessive on certain instruments, with single trade loss potentially representing too high a percentage of total capital
Lack of position count limits and same-direction duplicate entry checks may lead to overexposure
No spread filtering means trades execute even when spreads widen during high volatility periods
Recount mechanism has no retry upper limit, potentially陷入loop when indicator data is abnormal
